name: PiquerayLogo
description: Piqueray logo. Two Couleur variants, extracted from the Figma COMPONENT_SET « PiquerayLogo » on DS · Atomes, reviewed and adopted — not authored. The orange marque is constant; only the wordmark ink changes with Couleur — Default is the blue wordmark, Blanc the white wordmark for a dark surface (ds.header composes the Blanc variant on its noir-bleuté nav).
